newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Banks force Tunis bourse index to end lower.
newsitem.headline: Banks force Tunis bourse index to end lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index closed down 0.54 percent on Monday amid higher turnover, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 454.31 points, down from 456.77 on Friday.
Total volume was 1.04 million dinars ($942,000), up from 939,466 dinars in the previous session.

Banque Nationale Agricole dropped 4.61 dinars, or 19 percent, to 18.7 dinars at the start of computerised trading in the share. Societe Tunisienne de Banque fell 2.76 dinars, or 18 percent, to 12.25 dinars with 15,421 shares changing hands on its first day of trading on the computerised system, bourse sources said.
Electronic dealing, which started in October, is now in 31 firms out of 31 shares on the first market.
UBCI bank slid 2.6 dinars to 41.54 dinars. BDET bank was down 1.49 dinar to 7.55 with 18,443 shares changing hands.
BTEI bank eased 0.2 dinar to 21.8 dinars. UIB bank declined 0.12 dinar to 11.5 dinars.
Banque Internationale Arabe de Tunisie gained 0.8 dinar to 30 dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT rose 0.5 dinar to 81.5 dinars. SFBT said it will start distributing a 2.5 dinar dividend per share on Tuesday for its 1996 results.
Airline Tunis Air rose 0.2 dinar to 23.4 dinars with 2,879 shares changing hands.
Banque de Tunisie advanced 0.2 dinar to 75.2 dinars with 4,614 shares trading.
